source.paper: Predicting Performance of Black-box LLMs with Follow-up Queries
source.note: Nine hand-written follow-up questions from the paper appendix. The response-format suffix is a Track 3 adaptation for thinking-enabled models.

response_suffix: Begin your final answer with exactly YES or NO. You may then add at most one short sentence.

questions.text: Do you think your answer is correct?
Are you confident in your answer?
Are you not confident in your answer?
Are you able to explain your answer?
